name: Comix
description: Comix (comix.to) manga provider for Seanime. Automatically loads the current signing and response decoding module. If Cloudflare requires clearance, Chrome on the Seanime host captures the cookie and matching User-Agent after you complete its check.
author: Pal & Ari-03

fields.name: cfClearance
fields.label: Optional manual cf_clearance cookie for a Seanime server without a display. Leave both fields blank for automatic setup.

fields.name: userAgent
fields.label: Optional User-Agent from the same browser as the manual cookie. Leave both fields blank for automatic setup.
